result.summary: Updates the `-ipcbind` command-line help text to include an example of setting `max-connections` on the default Unix domain socket (`unix:,max-connections=8`). It clarifies that the trailing colon is required when specifying options without an explicit socket path.
result.problem: Users configuring multiprocess Bitcoin nodes with `-ipcbind` do not have clear help text showing how to supply options like `max-connections` while keeping the default Unix socket path.
evidence: Addresses issue #36657: 'Clarify -ipcbind syntax when using max-connections with the default Unix socket'.
result.card: This PR updates the help text for the `-ipcbind` command-line argument to provide an example of configuring options on the default Unix socket (`unix:,max-connections=8`). Previously, the documentation did not make clear that a trailing colon was required when passing options without an explicit socket path. This resolves issue #36657 by improving command-line help documentation for multiprocess setups.

risk.why: It only updates command-line help text for the -ipcbind option.
